view: Pergamon exceptionally steep Hellenistic theatre viewed diagonally down from upper seating, tightly spaced curved stone rows dropping to narrow stage terrace, broad Bakircay plain below, no free-standing amphitheatre outer walls, no sea directly at foot.

eras.title: Seats above the plain
eras.caption: Pergamon's theatre descends steeply below the acropolis. Its rows of stone seats fit into the hillside, letting the terrain do much of the structural work while opening a view over the plain below.
